principles: No single provider is authoritative across Crypto, OTC FX, futures/index context, macro and on-chain domains.
Primary and backup paths should avoid the same legal entity, infrastructure and normalization failure domain where practical.
Authoritative cross-check sources are preferred when available even if they are not the operational primary feed.
Data failover and execution-venue failover are different control problems and must never share identical automation rules.
Unresolved jurisdiction, client-class, licensing or required non-display rights block production promotion.
Unknown provider state or irreconcilable divergence fails closed for affected decisions.

preferred_pairing_rules: Use one normalized multi-venue vendor plus at least one venue-native feed for critical instruments.
Primary and backup normalized vendors should not be assumed independent until upstream source overlap is reviewed.
Order-flow evidence must retain original venue provenance.
unresolved_before_p01_g: Kaiko commercial quote and subscribed SLA

preferred_pairing_rules: Use an independent multi-source or normalized FX feed as research/market context and compare against the actual execution broker quote.
Never label any vendor/broker quote stream as consolidated global Spot FX volume.
Volume/order-flow fields remain BROKER/TICK/ECN/FUTURES/AGGREGATED_PROXY with coverage confidence.
unresolved_before_p01_g: dxFeed commercial quote/SLA and exact FX contributor coverage
Business non-display/automated-use rights for chosen backup
Owner jurisdiction/client class and eligible broker entity

preferred_pairing_rules: Use normalized futures data for operational ingestion/replay only with required exchange entitlements.
Contract specifications, calendars and benchmark definitions come from the exchange/owner authority.
For critical context signals, compare vendor values to official/exchange-derived reference where operationally possible.
unresolved_before_p01_g: Required depth/history tier and retention cost

preferred_pairing_rules: Index owner/licensed-source entitlement is authoritative for SPX/NDX/VIX use rights.
Secondary vendor can improve operational resilience but does not replace index licensing.
Official release source is authoritative for event time and first release.
FRED/ALFRED is preferred as revision-aware aggregation and convenience layer when series rights permit.
Store first release, previous-at-time and later revisions separately.
unresolved_before_p01_g: Series-by-series third-party rights where FRED republishes external data
Final official-source list for each macro family

preferred_pairing_rules: Block explorer/indexer output is convenient evidence, not identity proof by itself.
Critical on-chain signals should be reproducible against chain state or an independent indexer/node path.
unresolved_before_p01_g: Whether direct node or second indexer is economically justified

reasons: Unknown acknowledgement state can create duplicate orders.
Positions, balances, margin and liquidation conditions differ by venue.
A backup venue may have different product contracts, symbol semantics and legal eligibility.
Cross-venue failover can unintentionally increase portfolio or counterparty risk.

promotion_prerequisites: A5 risk approval and P16 firewall compatibility
crypto.failover_policy: On execution-venue degradation, halt new orders, reconcile all uncertain orders/fills/positions, enter DEGRADED or SAFE_MODE, then authorize future-order routing to a certified backup only after deterministic reconciliation.

forex.required_independence: separate broker/legal entity and independent account state
promotion_prerequisites: A5 risk approval and P16 firewall compatibility
forex.failover_policy: Broker outage never triggers immediate duplicate order replay. New-order routing remains halted until local and broker states reconcile; backup is used only for new intents after controlled switch.

future_automatic_failover_conditions: bounded divergence thresholds defined from empirical provider comparison
backup feed continuously validated before activation
switch_sequence: switch affected domain to backup if policy permits
preserve provider/source provenance in every event
fail_closed_conditions: divergence exceeds future approved threshold and cannot be adjudicated
source provenance is missing for risk-relevant fields

market_data: Critical tradable domains should not depend on one vendor for both operational feed and independent validation.
A single vendor may cover multiple context markets, but authoritative exchange/agency references remain separate.
Shared upstream exchanges/sources between aggregators must be documented to avoid false independence.
execution: Capital concentration limits are deferred to P15 but P01-F requires multiple eligible venue candidates before high-autonomy production.
Backup venue must be independently reconciled and operationally certified before use.
No withdrawal permission is required for trading API design.

p01_g_prerequisites: Owner country of residence/account jurisdiction supplied explicitly
Individual vs entity account decision supplied
Target products and intended venues confirmed
Kaiko/dxFeed and any other required enterprise quotes resolved if shortlisted
Index/exchange entitlements resolved for context sources
Final conditional shortlist revalidated against current provider availability and terms
